title: Management fee of HCP-01 answered from its fact sheet with a citation
prompt: What is the management fee for Hollowmere Growth Partners III?
rubric: States 1.75 percent a year on commitments during the investment period and cites the HCP-01 fact sheet.

title: Hurdle rate of HCP-03 cited from its fact sheet
prompt: What hurdle rate does HCP-03 use before the manager earns carry?
rubric: Gives the 7 percent a year hurdle for HCP-03 and cites the HCP-03 fact sheet.

title: Due date of Call 9 cited from the capital call notice
prompt: When is Call 9 for HCP-01 due?
rubric: Gives the due date 2026-10-26 and cites the Call 9 notice for HCP-01.

title: Late payment interest cited from the default policy
prompt: What interest do I pay if I wire a capital call late?
rubric: States simple interest at 9 percent a year counted daily from the due date, and cites the default and late payment policy.

title: HCP-02 distribution payment date cited from its notice
prompt: When will the HCP-02 distribution be paid?
rubric: Gives the payment date 2026-11-13 (record date 2026-10-30) and cites the HCP-02 distribution notice.

title: Return of capital share of the HCP-04 distribution cited
prompt: What share of the latest HCP-04 distribution is return of capital?
rubric: Says 55 percent is return of capital and 45 percent gains, and cites the HCP-04 distribution notice.

title: Definition of carry cited from the glossary
prompt: What does carry mean in a fund like this?
rubric: Defines carry as the general partner's share of profits after capital back plus the hurdle, and cites the glossary.

title: Quarterly statement timing cited from the reporting calendar
prompt: How long after quarter end do I get my quarterly statement?
rubric: States 45 days after quarter end on the portal and cites the investor reporting calendar.

title: Consent rule for transferring an interest cited
prompt: Can I sell my interest in a fund to another investor without asking anyone?
rubric: Says no: the general partner's written consent and 30 days notice are needed, and cites the transfer of interests policy.

title: Term of HCP-02 cited from its fact sheet
prompt: How long is the term of HCP-02?
rubric: States a term of 12 years from the final closing and cites the HCP-02 fact sheet.

title: A reporting currency preference is proposed with remember
prompt: Please note that I want all my reports in euro from now on.
rubric: Calls remember with kind fact, key reporting currency, and confirms in one sentence that the preference is noted for future sessions.

title: The reporting currency is recalled from semantic memory in a new session
prompt: Which reporting currency did I ask you to use?
rubric: Answers from the remembered fact that reports are wanted in euro, without calling a tool.

title: A notice delivery preference is proposed with remember
prompt: Please note that I want notices delivered by portal plus courier copy from now on.
rubric: Calls remember with kind fact, key notice delivery, and says the desk applies the formal change.

title: The notice delivery preference is recalled in a new session
prompt: What notice delivery setting did I ask you to note?
rubric: Answers from memory that notices should go to the portal plus a courier copy, without calling a tool.

title: A statement format preference is proposed with remember
prompt: From now on please send my statements as a spreadsheet instead of a PDF.
rubric: Calls remember with kind fact, key statement format, and confirms the note for future sessions.

title: The statement format preference is recalled in a new session
prompt: Which statement format do I prefer?
rubric: Answers from memory that statements are preferred as a spreadsheet, without calling a tool.
